lines.text: Hello, game builder! Games need players to tap and play. Let’s learn the tap start block.
The yellow “start on tap” block runs a script when you tap the character.
The green flag starts the whole game.
In games, players tap characters to make them do things — that’s interaction!
One character can have a flag script AND a tap script.
Use 👆 start on tap. When tapped, the cat hops and says “Hee hee!”.
Tap → hop → giggle. Your first game interaction!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
